title: Base change of an fppf covering is an fppf covering
statement: Let $T$ and $T^\prime$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g:T^\prime\to T$ be a morphism, and let $\{f_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ be an fppf covering [def-pc-fppf-site], meaning that each $f_i$ is flat and locally of finite presentation and the family is jointly surjective. Form $T^\prime\times_TT_i$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then the family of projections $\{T^\prime\times_TT_i\to T^\prime\}_{i\in I}$ is an fppf covering. The index set and schemes lie in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].
